title: Bar
description: Fiori bar (header, subheader, footer, floating footer) with start, middle and end content.

usage.summary: Arrange page or dialog header and footer content in start, centered and end areas.
useWhen: Keep a title centered while navigation or actions occupy the start and end of a header or footer.
Place page-level footer actions in a footer or floating footer.
Use design="header", "subheader", "footer" or "floating-footer" to match the surrounding region.

avoidWhen.when: Group related actions with arrow-key navigation and responsive overflow.
Provide a universal product header with branding, global search, notifications and profile access.
